intro: Hallowed Rune is an introductory quest for fledgling dwarven priests in Coldridge Valley. Sten Stoutarm passes along an inscribed rune from priest trainer Branstock Khalder, summoning the novice inside Anvilmar to deepen their connection with the Holy Light.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the adventurer trainer Branstock. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ach! Ya made it, friend! Wonderful!
I was gonna say, I was about to lose faith that ye'd arrive at all... Get it, lose faith? It's a joke, lad... Aww, nevermind. Ya didn't come here for me bad jokes anyway.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm the one who can train ya as you start to find your way around Coldridge Valley. When ya feel yer ready, come back to me and we'll see about maybe teaching you a new spell or two to fend off the valley from them blasted troggs.
Ya got the Light on yer side, along with all of Ironforge, friend... No pressure on ya to become somethin' special.
